title: Logarithmic asymptotics of the Gaussian upper tail
statement: Let $Z$ be a standard Gaussian random variable, and write $Q(t)=\mathbb{P}(Z>t)$ for its upper-tail probability. As $t\to+\infty$, $\log(1/Q(t))$ is asymptotic to $t^2/2$, meaning their ratio tends to $1$.
